# Libarchive test archives

Tiny, non-game upstream test data, decoded from the following uuencoded fixtures
on 26 October 2026. `COPYING.libarchive` preserves the upstream licence notice.

- `rar5.rar`: [stored RAR5 fixture](https://github.com/libarchive/libarchive/blob/master/libarchive/test/test_read_format_rar5_stored.rar.uu), contains `helloworld.txt`.
- `rar4-link.rar`: [RAR4 fixture](https://github.com/libarchive/libarchive/blob/master/libarchive/test/test_read_format_rar.rar.uu), includes ordinary text and a symlink; verifies the importer refuses links.

ZIP/7Z and malformed-path fixtures are generated by `PcGamesTests.cpp` in a
temporary directory. These tests do not establish support for encrypted,
split-volume or every compressed RAR variant.
